title: Relax Fishing — 3rd update of my mobile fishing game. Mechanics reworked, would love your honest opinion
author: SeaworthinessFit6280
selftext:
Hi everyone!

This is the third time I’m sharing my little fishing game. Thanks to everyone who left feedback last time: I went through all of it and made a lot of changes.

**What’s new in this version:**

* Reworked fishing mechanics: different fish behave differently (pike makes short sharp surges, carp goes on long runs, catfish just holds deep). Fights are a bit easier, and the tension bar is clearer.
* New cast accuracy meter: stop the slider on green for a precise cast and a faster bite.
* Landing net button: when the fish is close, you have to hit it in time.
* Updated shop with new prices and better balance between rods, reels and lines.
* New locations.
* Graphics fixes: smoother day/night transitions, better water reflections, readable text.
* A rewritten tutorial with an old fisherman who explains everything step by step. Plus a few surprises: sometimes you’ll pull out something that isn’t a fish 🙂

The game is made for phones first, so it plays best on mobile in the browser. If people like it and I keep working on it, I’d like to release it as a proper mobile app in the future.

I’ve been making it for about 2.5 weeks using Claude, ChatGPT and Runway. Honestly, I’m not sure if that’s good or bad progress for that time. Part of the slowdown is that I keep hitting usage limits.

As always, I’d really appreciate your honest opinion:

* Is it fun?
* What feels confusing or annoying?
* What would make you come back and play again?

Play here (free, in browser): [https://kholodniuk.itch.io/relax-fishing](https://kholodniuk.itch.io/relax-fishing)

Thanks for playing! 🎣
